author: Killsschi72
quote: Baught a ps5 pro for this game just to be met with a underwhelming gameplay and characters with the personality of a brick wall. Ok Gameplay loop but 100$ for no Pc port and a extremely reatrictive gameplay loop is a buch of bull **** I feel bad for anyone else who was also coned into thinking that this game is actually good. **** from 16 years ago Fallout new Vegas can have a more compelling main character with no voice acting is beyond me. Also a laggy mess at only 30-24 fps Hopefully Online will be good i will hate play this game so it feels like i am getting my moneys worth.
